results.implementation_boundary: qiayuanl/legged_control gait/state/input/WBC/hybrid-command interfaces; deterministic instantaneous friction-constrained force planner and MuJoCo acceleration-level WBC replace ROS/OCS2 SQP; not Quadruped-PyMPC

render.camera: free camera following A1 base; fixed world floor reference
render.overlay: scenario, difficulty, time, command, displacement, height, fall status

threshold_definitions.attitude: maximum absolute roll or pitch at any control sample
threshold_definitions.contact_agreement: fraction of foot/control-sample booleans where planned stance equals measured MuJoCo foot contact
threshold_definitions.dynamics_residual: maximum L2 norm of post-torque-saturation generalized equations-of-motion residual; translational rows are N and rotational rows are N m
threshold_definitions.fall: base height <0.18 m or |roll|/|pitch| >0.9 rad at any control sample
threshold_definitions.height: base z relative to the scenario's commanded base height
threshold_definitions.torque: applied hybrid-command torque; A1 effort limit is 33.5 N m
threshold_definitions.velocity: RMSE of world-frame vx/vy and yaw-rate tracking
